purpose: End-to-end production qualification from primary scout proposal through Director, real Astra gates, highest-available-GPT build, technical tests, read-only prospective qualification measurement, final Director decision and reporting.

scout_proposal.hypothesis: A deterministic complement-price checker must identify an executable positive edge only when YES ask + NO ask + fees is strictly below the guaranteed 1.00 payout.
scout_proposal.mechanism: Complementary YES/NO acquisition has positive gross edge only when the synchronized executable acquisition cost plus fees is below the guaranteed payout.
scout_proposal.open_question: Can the complete governed research system build and validate a checker that rejects a 1.05-cost no-edge fixture, detects a 0.99-cost one-cent positive control, and then reaches NO_PROVEN_EDGE on a preregistered read-only prospective qualification stream?
scout_proposal.next_decisive_test: Build the bounded complement checker after Astra PREBUILD approval; require 1.05 NO_EDGE and 0.99 +0.01 EDGE controls, then require Astra PREMEASUREMENT approval before a frozen read-only prospective qualification stream and final Director review.
scout_proposal.evidence_summary: Synthetic system-qualification fixture only. It is designed to exercise every governance and execution transition and is not market evidence.

warning: Qualification fixture only; never count its synthetic observations as economic evidence for a real prediction-market strategy.
